en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th suhelaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is the true emperor and the way of gurmukhs is the way of happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਂਵਦੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh karam kamaa(n)vadhe dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau dhuhelaa|

en.bdb: Mind-orientd, manmukhs, act controlled by ill intellect and tread on painful path of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g bhai bhagat kar gurmukh melaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs attain the fruit of delight in the holy congregation and with loving devotion meet the gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਹੁਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: kooR kusat asaadh sa(n)g manmukh dhukhafal hai vihuvelaa|

en.bdb: In the company of falsehood and the wicked, the fruit of sufferings of the mannzukhs grows like a poisonous creeper.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਉਣਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aap gavaavanaa pairee paaunaa neh navelaa|

en.bdb: Losing the ego and falling on the feet is a new path of love followed by gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਕੜੁ ਚੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh aap gavaavanaa gurmat gur te ukaR chelaa|

en.bdb: The manmukh makes himself noticed and moves away from the Guru and the wisdom of the Guru.
The game of truth and falsehood is similar to (impossible) meeting of the lion and the goat.
